answer: Every attestation ships a Verifiable Delay proof: a serial hash chain seeded by the epoch number and the identity's own last output, each block echoing the one before, sized at five hours of single-core work. Faster hardware buys little because the delay is sequential, and a chain unfinished inside the six hour window voids the answer, burning 20 POA of standing. Fifty clones need fifty continuously hashing cores, near $6 monthly each, $300, and a shared box stalls every chain on it. A glacier grinds centimetres daily, and no pile of shovels hurries it; the tundra below keeps its own pace.
